item.title: How have Virginia railways been affected by dangerous snow, ice storm?
item.description: After a dangerous snow and ice storm swept through the Commonwealth over the weekend, extreme cold and rapid temperature changes are continuing to impact rail infrastructure, according to rail officials.

item.title: Virginia crews on full force to clean secondary roads with heavy ice, officials say
item.description: The Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) and Department of Public Works (DPW) officials said their crews remain in full force on secondary and subdivision roads.

item.title: LIST: Central Virginia schools closed, going virtual Thursday, Friday due to hazardous conditions
item.description: Many Central Virginia school districts will be closed or will shift to virtual learning on Thursday due to hazardous driving conditions following a snow and ice storm.

item.title: Waiting on heat repairs? What an attorney says you should know
item.description: Cold temperatures have stuck around Central Virginia this winter, and if you are waiting on heating repairs to finish, a legal expert says there are responsibilities both tenants and landlords are required to fulfill.

item.title: Dozens of service requests for ice removal in Richmond go incomplete, residents frustrated with landlords
item.description: Sidewalks, parking lots and alleys across the region are still coated in thick layers of slick ice. And residents have contacted 8News feeling frustrated with landlords and property owners not doing enough to clear it. "They might’ve came out, but they ain’t came to my house," Alexander Brown, a resident at Ashton Square Apartments in Richmond said about management at his complex.

item.title: Man went missing from Colonial Heights before winter storm, could be in danger
item.description: A 34-year-old man who went missing out of Colonial Heights days before a powerful weekend winter storm is still unaccounted for a week later.

item.title: Plans for large-scale data center in Hanover withdrawn
item.description: Plans have been withdrawn for a 400-acre data center project set to be built along Ashland Road after pushback from Hanover County leaders and many concerned residents.

item.title: Man found dead under Richmond walkway during below-freezing weather
item.description: A man was found dead under a walkway outside of a Richmond community center on Tuesday, with ongoing below-freezing conditions believed to be a factor in his tragic death.

item.title: StormTracker8: Snow likely Saturday into Sunday
'Our own backyard': Protesters, Hanover officials oppose proposed ICE facility in Ashland
item.description: The Hanover County Board of Supervisors is not supporting plans by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to build a processing facility in Ashland.
